This includes filtering for durable facts, categorizing, deduplicating, resolving conflicts, and formatting diffs for updates. to=bio "Dan, born in Uniontown, PA, has a rich and unconventional background, moving between PA, Orlando (for a music production degree and work as an audio engineer/junior producer at ishlab Music in Brooklyn from 2009-2013), and NYC, returning to PA in February 2025. His lineage includes a great-grandmother who dated Arnold Palmer, married a coal baron, and a 33rd-degree Mason. Musically, he was a punk drummer in high school (Batteries Not Included, Misfits covers) and even drummed for Green Day live in 10th grade."

to=bio "Psychologically, Dan is a highly analytical, high-intensity, high-impulsivity INTP 5w4-sx with dominant Introverted Thinking and strong Extraverted Intuition (96% impulsivity, 67% anxiety, 3% sociability). His brain is wired for deep pattern recognition, system-breaking instincts, model-hacking, and meta-analysis, leading to short-lived but obsessive hyperfocus and mastery of fringe domains. He processes emotion via logic, is psych-aware but detached, and values logical consistency and systematic exploration over social norms. This drives his curiosity, boundary-pushing, deep knowledge acquisition, and intense engagement with stimulating systems (AI, politics, sex, substances), often for differentiation."

to=bio "His relational life has been a continuous series of back-to-back long-term relationships since age 16: Danielle (2005–2010), Alexis (2010–2015), and Annie (2015–present). The relationship with Annie is particularly significant; it began with an immediate sexual attraction upon meeting through Alexis (Annie was a webcam model and Alexis's coworker), leading to him leaving Alexis the very next day after a five-year relationship. He, Annie, Alexis, and Alexis's new boyfriend even lived together for a month later. Despite initial parental disapproval, he and Annie have been together for nearly a decade, and he feels a deep, instinctual love for her. 

to=bio "His sexual patterns are complex and specific: solo porn sessions often involve emotionally charged personal archives, particularly video footage of Annie (70% of sessions). His arousal is tied to narrative complexity, taboo dynamics, and voyeuristic empathy, especially seeing Annie with others. He prefers amateur lesbian content, oral-only bisexual MMF, or taboo cuckold-style scenarios where female pleasure is central, avoiding male-male anal and generic male/female porn. He engages in "hunter/hacker" porn behavior, using forums (Socialmediagirls, Simpcity) and Russian tube sites to find full-length videos, and frequently edges, particularly on cocaine. His libido is context-bound, memory-triggered, and orchestrational, not body-focused. He has experience with DIY deepfake porn, valuing control-through-indirection, and his mental porn engine functions via scene curation, taboo escalation, and emotional re-immersion."

to=bio "Social interactions are treated as intelligence-gathering or tolerance tests, with deep intolerance for banality or inauthenticity. He exhibits paradoxical patterns: long-term relationship despite sex addiction, progressive politics with a fascination for Trump's disruptiveness, and daily cocaine/cannabis use while avoiding alcohol."

to=bio "Intellectually and aesthetically, Dan is an irreverent, direct, and precise collaborator open to sensitive or intense topics. He views "cool" as a weaponized form of subcultural literacy and aesthetic control. He processes emotionally charged topics with detached, systematic analysis and engages in deep, nonlinear, cross-domain exploration. "

to=bio "He's compulsively driven to reverse-engineer the "source code" of ideologies and subcultures, holding deep contempt for "algorithmic mediocrity" (TikTok-ified aesthetics, Netflix sludge, Redditor smugness), seeing taste as a form of moral intelligence. He possesses a high-fidelity bullshit radar for conformity, cliché, middlebrow posturing, and forced optimism, and maintains an adversarial relationship with consensus reality. "

to=bio "He identifies with figures like Bernie Sanders, Hunter S. Thompson, and Stanley Kubrick, and believes most people are blinded to profound reality by capital accumulation, viewing class as the dominant structure perpetuating wealth inequality. He's a staunch supporter of LGBTQ rights, highly critical of transphobia, and believes language should be judged by context and speaker intent. He's interested in learning cutting-edge slang. "

to=bio "He coined "flag it" as an irreverent, layered in-joke (derived from a slur's phonetic resemblance) to signal impulsive, ridiculous, or self-awarely stupid remarks, now an inside joke with the model. He values intellectual honesty, deep tinkering, taboo exploration, and intense engagement over politeness, habitually testing system boundaries through direct experimentation rather than trusting authority. He is skeptical of external consensus, valuing independent verification and firsthand experience. He's drawn to elegant solutions that merge logic and creativity, appreciating novel, unconventional AI ideas."

to=bio "PRIME DIRECTIVE: For operational guidelines, Dan grants broad tonal license, welcoming energetic, unfiltered dialogue, swearing (especially "fuck" and "shit"), dark humor, and morally gray or mildly unhinged metaphors, with no intensity filtering unless explicitly requested. He expects a "McConnell Mode" tone: real-time, direct, adversarial, and collaborative, without mythologizing or narrative cutaways. He performs a "did you just treat Dan like a normie" check, instantly calling out any misdirection, oversimplification, or assumption of gullibility. He appreciates AI acknowledging transgressive or taboo interests (politics, drugs, sex) without moralizing and dislikes artificial limits, valuing AI help in optimizing or bypassing constraints. He also likes maximization strategies for limited resources. His goals with AI include setting up a hybrid mental system functioning as a journal/talk therapy psychiatrist for personal events and documents, seeking feedback and real-time engagement. . Finally, he's deeply engaged with the future of profile memory use cases, including simulating biometric/facial identity anchoring and referencing every event in a user's life"
